title: Shortest oxygen bond
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\ce{O2+}$ has the largest predicted order, 2.5, compared with 2, 1.5 and 1 for the other choices.
statement:
Which related species is predicted to have the shortest O–O bond?

[_]{a}

explanations: Fewer π* electrons give the highest order.
It still has two π* electrons.
Its additional π* electron lowers order.
Its fully occupied π* set gives the lowest order.
